comment: Candidate pool for the Power Rankings — current contenders only; permanent institutions live in classics.json (hall of fame, not scored). compute-buzz.mjs measures each spot's Reddit mentions and Google review velocity, then ranks the top 5. Add or remove spots freely — aliases are the search terms used for Reddit matching. Optional `opened` (YYYY-MM, approximate is fine) gives recently opened spots a newcomer boost: ×1.2 under 4 months, ×1.1 under 8. `known_for_es` is the Spanish blurb shown when the site is toggled to español. Expanded to ~29 spots across every Valley city on 2026-07-20 (sources: Yelp/TripAdvisor/RestaurantJi city lists + local coverage); audience nominations via IG DM get added here after verifying the spot exists.
